Energy Levels Text: You may still expererience high energy from ovulation, still making it easier for high intensity activities. Muscles may work longer without getting tired, and it the body will burn fat and not glucose. The best excercises to do are low intensity workouts such as cycling and running.
Type of food: During this phase it is best to eat carbs and proteins, as when doing excercies it will make your body rely on glucose less. Foods rich with vitamin B and healthy facts will also help to support hormonal balance, and therefore are recommended.
Concentration Levels: Through the luteal phase, the dynamic complexity of the brain remains high but the activty patterns change. This supports deeper thinking, reflection and social sensitivity.
Health aspect: The luteal phase is normally 12-14 days. If your luteal phase is 10 days or less it is recommended you go talk to a specialist as there is a possbility that you may experience Luteal phase deficiency (LPD). Some possibile symptoms include spotting, short cycle, and >10 day luteal phase. This disease may contribute to infertility and lead to misscarages.
